% Known-good \problem-macro sheet in the current template style: workspace as
% the macro's optional argument (inside the unbreakable minipage), plus one
% multi-part problem whose workspace lives in the nested list's itemsep — the
% floor check must NOT double-charge that region (the enumerate pass owns it).
\documentclass{article}\usepackage{tikz,enumitem}
\newcounter{prob}
\newcommand{\problem}[2][0pt]{\par\vspace{0.4cm}\noindent\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\stepcounter{prob}\noindent\textbf{\large\theprob.}\quad #2\par\vspace*{#1}\end{minipage}\par}
\begin{document}
\problem[5cm]{$a=6$, $b=8$. Find $c$.}
\problem[5cm]{$a=5$, $c=13$. Find $b$.}
\problem[8cm]{$a=7$, $b=24$. Find $c$.}
\problem{Given $f(x) = 3x^2 - 2x + 1$, find:}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*), itemsep=3cm, leftmargin=1.5cm]
  \item $f(0) =$~\ansblank
  \item $f(-2) =$~\ansblank
\end{enumerate}
\end{document}
